summary: Implemented every stub in my 38 assigned files (compat, datasets, emplike, gam, genmod/cov_struct, miscmodels/ordinal_model, multivariate/plots, regression/dimred, sandbox, stats lilliefors/inference, tsa ets, denton, dynamic_factor_mq), adding missing helpers that the code referenced; several model files (DFM EM and ETS) are approximations that are not validated against reference values. The last full-suite run did not finish before I reported, so there is no final count; partial runs showed lilliefors 9/9, denton 2/2, covariance solve 3/3, dimred 3/5, ordinal 12/22 passing, with other failures caused by base-layer breakage in other builders' files.
